destination.coordinate_basis: district representative point (not a weather station)

query_period.note: The requested dates select the calendar years they overlap. Every value is an annual (calendar-year) figure and is not restricted to the requested days or months; month-specific values are not available.

weather.source: NASA POWER daily point data (MERRA-2/POWER), aggregated by year

units.avg_temperature_c: degC, annual mean of daily 2 m temperature
units.max_temperature_c: degC, highest daily maximum in the year
units.min_temperature_c: degC, lowest daily minimum in the year

caveats: Gridded, model-derived values at the district representative point, not station observations.
Annual figures only; monthly or travel-window weather is not provided by this table.

heatwave_threshold.source: Derived from NASA POWER daily T2M_MAX
heatwave_threshold.definition: heatwave_days: days with modelled daily maximum temperature >= 45 degC; severe_heatwave_days: >= 47 degC.
caveats: A temperature-threshold indicator from gridded data. It is NOT an official IMD-declared heatwave record (IMD declarations also use departure-from-normal and spatial/temporal rules).

malaria.source: NCVBDC district-wise malaria tables (extracted from PDF)
caveats: Raw reported counts. Not rates and not comparable across districts of different population; no incidence is computed.
Only districts successfully matched to the Census-2011 master are retained; a missing district-year is unknown, not zero.
A row with data_coverage THROUGH_APRIL_2024 is a partial year.
State-level totals shown as context for the destination's state. They are NOT observations for this district and are shared by every district of the state.
Raw counts; not rates and not comparable across states of different population.
Rows marked PROVISIONAL_* cover only part of the year.

flood.source: India Flood Inventory v3, deterministic LGD-to-Census mapping

units.flood_event_count: recorded flood events in the year

caveats: The table lists only district-years with at least one recorded event. A year with no row is NOT confirmed to have had no flood.
Only districts with a deterministic LGD-to-Census mapping are present (502 of 640 in the current build); other districts are unknown, not flood-free.
flood.status_reason: The destination has records in other years but none in the requested period. This is unknown, not zero.

precautions.text: Plan strenuous outdoor activity outside the hottest hours, drink water regularly and know the signs of heat illness. Check current IMD heat advisories before travel.
precautions.supported_by: Modelled days at or above 45 degC appear in the returned years.

precautions.text: Reduce mosquito bites (repellent, covered clothing, nets where advised) and seek medical care promptly for fever. Ask a health professional about travel-health advice.
precautions.supported_by: Reported malaria cases appear for this district in the returned years.

precautions.text: Dengue mosquitoes bite mainly by day: use repellent and covered clothing, avoid standing water, and seek medical care for high fever or severe symptoms.
precautions.supported_by: Reported dengue cases appear for the destination's state in the returned years.

caveats: Experimental. Target: at least one NASA POWER-derived day >= 45 degC during the target calendar year (not an IMD-declared heatwave).
District-level annual classification; not a travel-date or month forecast.
The raw score is uncalibrated and must not be read as a probability or converted to a risk level.

prediction.score_interpretation: Uncalibrated model score. Do not interpret it as a reliable real-world probability.
prediction.target_definition: At least one day with maximum temperature at or above 45 C during the next calendar year, according to the training target.
limitations: District-level annual prediction, not a month-specific forecast.
Raw model scores have not been shown to be reliably calibrated.
Aggregation of existing data, not a forecast; no overall risk score or safety verdict is produced.
All sources are annual or coarser. Month- or day-specific values are not available and are never derived from annual data.
A missing record means unknown. It is never treated as zero.
Disease counts are raw reported counts, not rates; do not compare them across places of different population.
Dengue is state-level context shared by all districts of the state.
Correlation shown by co-occurring data is not causation.
disclaimer: Decision support only. This is not a diagnosis, an emergency alert, a guarantee of safety or a substitute for official advisories (IMD, NCVBDC/state health departments, state disaster-management authorities).
